children: Woolworths's trading update pleases Jefferies. Australian food sales growth of 6.1% on a like-for-like basis was ahead of Jefferies's forecast rise of 5.8%. This translates into total sales growth of 6.9%. Analyst Michael Simotas says it implies sales growth moderated to 6.0% in the last six weeks of 1Q, from 7.6% in the first eight weeks. "This was post the Ooshies promo campaign and is still a very healthy rate of growth," Jefferies says. Momentum has continued into October, with run rate ahead of market 2Q forecasts. That suggests consensus upgrades will be forthcoming, Jefferies says. It had a hold call and A$39.50/share price target on Woolworths ahead of the update. Woolworths is up 0.5% at A$41.21. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
